articles.title: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new public benefit fund that could address AI job disruption
articles.summary: Anthropic said Sunday it plans to commit 5% of its shares to a new public benefit fund, with the stake potentially increasing as the company's valuation grows. Subject to shareholder approval, the fund would immediately commit 5% of Anthropic's shares, with the board adding, at its discretion, an additional 2% for every 50% increase in the company's value above a set baseline that has yet to be disclosed.

articles.title: Brent crude hovers near $109 a barrel as Ukraine resumes energy strikes, tankers attacked in Middle East
articles.summary: Crude oil prices hovered near recent highs on Sunday as traders weighed a Ukraine bombing of oil facilities in Russia and more tankers coming under attack in the Persian Gulf. Petersburg exports about 120,000 barrels per day of refined products, mostly fuel oil, according to data from Kpler. Iran has escalated attacks on tankers in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman in an effort to choke off crude oil exports from the region.

articles.title: India’s Finance Minister blames easy exits and excess liquidity for equity market's underperformance
articles.summary: Since January, India's key benchmark indexes have slipped nearly 12%, as per LSEG data, even though the country's economic growth has been resilient amid trade uncertainty and geopolitical shocks. India has gained a reputation as an anti-artificial intelligence trade, while markets like Taiwan and Korea, with AI champions, have attracted strong investment flows.
